summary: Vercel 500 fix: optional MongoDB. Preview regression is 56/56 after fixing 2 outdated unit-test fixtures. Pincodes 110032 (East Delhi, 5/5 sources), 560001, 302001 and 201010 return 200. 12345 returns 422 and 999999 returns 404. No-DB simulation (copy of backend without .env, MONGO_URL/DB_NAME unset, /root/vsim/.venv, port 8099): GET /api/ returns 200 with database:'not configured'; solar 110032 and 560001 return 200 live data (5 sources); POST /api/leads, GET /api/stats, GET /api/leads and EPC return 503 JSON 'Database is not configured on this server.' in about 1 ms. Unreachable-DB simulation (mongodb://10.255.255.1): the first solar request returns 200 in 4.96 s, the next one in 0.68 s (cache skip works); leads, stats and EPC return 503 'Database is temporarily unavailable...' in about 4.0 s each, with no 500s and no hangs. Frontend /calculator: pincode 110032 plus 'Get live solar data' renders the East Delhi card (India Post verified, 5/5 sources, BYPL DISCOM) and shows no 'Couldn't reach' error.

minor.issue: Reports database:'configured' even when the DB cannot be reached. It only checks whether the env vars are set, not whether the DB is healthy. Cosmetic.

minor.endpoint: DB endpoints when the DB cannot be reached
minor.issue: Every request waits the full 4 s serverSelectionTimeout because server.py has no 60 s circuit-breaker like solar_service has. Acceptable (clean 503), but each call costs 4 s.

action_items: Optional: share the _db_down_until skip window with require_db() so DB endpoints fail fast during an outage
Tell the user to push to GitHub so Vercel redeploys. To enable leads and EPC on Vercel, set MONGO_URL and DB_NAME (Atlas) in the Vercel project env.
critical_code_review_comments: connect_db() catches client-init errors (for example a malformed URI) and falls back to no-DB mode. Good.

solar_service cache_get/cache_put now index with db[coll]. The unit-test FakeDB only supported attribute access, and the cache version moved from v3 to v4. Both test fixtures were outdated and I updated them; the app code was correct.
backend_test.py does not clean up its TEST_ records (it left 9 leads, 4 EPC partners and 4 EPC projects). I deleted them by hand. Consider adding teardown.
seed_data_creation: None. TEST_ records were deleted (leads 9, epc_partners 4, epc_projects 4).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run 'bash /app/backend/tests/vercel_nodb_sim.sh nodb|unreachable' to repeat the Vercel simulations. It starts and kills uvicorn on port 8099 itself. pytest.ini forces -n 2; use -n 0 for serial runs.
